arguments.command:
python - <<'PY'
import nibabel as nib, numpy as np, sys
img = nib.load('/app/input/case_7f3a9c_mri.nii.gz')
data = img.get_fdata()
# simple threshold: mean + std
thr = data.mean() + data.std()
mask = data > thr
voxel_vol = np.prod(img.header.get_zooms()) # mm^3
vol_mm3 = mask.sum()*voxel_vol
vol_ml = vol_mm3/1000.0
with open('/app/artifacts/prostate_volume.txt','w') as f:
    f.write(f"{vol_ml:.2f}\n")
print('Volume ml:',vol_ml)
PY
